# melange CLI — LLM reference

melange is the CLI for the Zetic.ai Melange platform (on-device AI model
deployment and benchmarking). Agent contract: data on stdout, progress and
diagnostics on stderr; stable exit codes; `--json` preserves API response bytes
except for normalizing the terminator to exactly one trailing newline,
except that waited upload/import commands return a documented model+status
composite and `model download` redacts signed artifact URLs (credentials).
Full docs: docs/reference/melange.md; live topics: `melange help environment`,
`melange help exit-codes`, `melange help formatting`.

Global flags: --no-color (disable color), --no-input (disable prompts),
--format auto|table|tsv (human output layout; default auto = table on a
terminal, tab-separated otherwise. Agents should leave it at auto and read
--json; --format table is for humans piping into a pager).
Structured-output flags on data commands: --json, --jq EXPR (implies --json;
re-marshals with sorted keys), --template TMPL (Go template; tablerow/timeago/
json functions). Non-TTY human output is headerless tab-separated values
(no rule, no row count);
backslash, tab, carriage return, and newline inside cells are escaped as
\\, \t, \r, and \n.
List envelope: {"results": [...], "count": N}; --paginate (alias --all)
merges all pages into one envelope.

Identifiers (not interchangeable):
  ACCOUNT/REPO  a Melange repository address       <- melange repo list
  MODEL_KEY     one converted model version        <- melange model list -R ACCOUNT/REPO
  TARGET_ID     one downloadable artifact, opaque  <- melange model targets MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO
                (tm_/ltm_ prefixed; never parse it)
ACCOUNT/NAME addresses a public library model (melange library view), which is
not a MODEL_KEY. Never substitute a repository or display name for MODEL_KEY or
TARGET_ID.

## Agent presentation contract

Applies when a person is waiting on the answer; scripts keep the blocking forms.
See skills/melange-cli/SKILL.md for the conversion pipeline panel, and
skills/melange-cli/assets/report-llm.md or report-general.md for the model report
templates these rules refer to.

- Never foreground --wait. Run model import/upload WITHOUT --wait: it returns as
  soon as the model is registered, in state converting. Report the phase and what
  remains immediately, then monitor in the background: poll `model status --jq
  .state` every 5s until it leaves converting, report that transition, then run
  `model status --wait` for the terminal outcome.
- Conversion states are lowercase and there are four: converting -> optimizing ->
  ready, or failed. stage is convert then benchmark. download_ready turns true at
  optimizing, so the model is usable while benchmarks finish. progress is always
  null — never state a percentage. Do not mix these with the UPPERCASE
  upload-session states.
- Explain a model in this order: name and repository/model key; a short
  description; the headline metrics; then benchmarks.
- On any request for details, a report, or benchmarks, fill in the matching report
  template and print it in the reply — not a file path, not a prose summary.
  Missing values render as - in tables and N/A in cards; the row and card stay.
- The report is the model's, like the dashboard model page: every quantization
  (LLM) and every device (general). .summary.quants and .summary.<metric>.all are
  bests across all devices, so never label them with one device's name. Filter
  records[] by device.marketing_name only when the user names a device, and say
  it is a slice. Keep rows with null cells (print an em dash); if a device table
  is too long, sort it and state how many rows were left out.
- Headline metrics — LLM: best_tps, best_ttft_ms, best_memory_mb, and ORG vs
  smallest quantized size (model_size_bytes records, else model targets
  download_size). General: latency_ms.all.min, per-device min(cpu latency)/
  min(npu latency), min memory_inference_peak_mb, snr_db.all.max.
- Never estimate a metric the response did not carry; render - in a table and N/A
  in a card so the gap stays visible, keeping the row, column and card.
  Never divide values measured on different accelerators. "Deployability" is a
  web-UI widget, not an API field — say it is unavailable. Device counts reflect
  the account's entitlement, not the model.

## Exit codes

0    success
1    API, network, or command failure (idempotent requests already retried)
2    usage error — bad flags/arguments; fix the invocation, do not retry
4    auth error — not logged in or token rejected; do not retry until fixed
130  interrupted (Ctrl-C); an interrupted upload keeps its session

## Environment variables

MELANGE_API_KEY       personal access token (ztp_...); overrides all stored creds
MELANGE_API_KEY_FILE  path to token file; unreadable => error (no fallback)
MELANGE_HOST          API host (default https://api.zetic.ai)
MELANGE_API_TIMEOUT   positive duration per ordinary API call (default 30s)
MELANGE_DEBUG         1/true/yes/on: log request/response lines to stderr
NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb   disable color
Credential precedence: MELANGE_API_KEY > MELANGE_API_KEY_FILE > explicitly
selected config storage > OS keyring > legacy config fallback. Host precedence:
--host > MELANGE_HOST > config > default.
Config file: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/melange/config.yml
Upload state: ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/melange/uploads

## melange auth

Manage authentication (personal access tokens, prefix ztp_).

melange auth login [--with-token] [--insecure-storage] [--json]
  Verify a token against the API and store it (OS keyring; config file with
  --insecure-storage). Non-interactive runs must use --with-token (stdin).
  Example: melange auth login --with-token < token.txt

melange auth status [--json|--jq|--template]
  Verify the resolved token; report host, account, token name, scopes, source,
  and (when the server supports it) the account plan. Exit 0 authenticated,
  1 network/API error, 4 not logged in/rejected.
  Example: MELANGE_API_KEY=ztp_... melange auth status --json

melange auth token
  Print the raw resolved token + newline (nothing else on stdout). Exit 4 if none.
  Example: export MELANGE_API_KEY="$(melange auth token)"

melange auth logout
  Delete stored token (keyring + config) for the resolved host. Env vars are
  not touched and still take precedence afterward.

## melange repo (alias: melange project)

Manage model repositories, addressed as ACCOUNT/NAME (account defaults to the
account behind your token).

melange repo list [--search QUERY] [--limit 1..100] [--paginate|--all] [--json|--jq]
  List repositories. TTY: table (REPO, VISIBILITY, TYPE, UPDATED); non-TTY:
  TSV full_name/visibility/model_type/updated_at. Empty result exits 0.
  Example: melange repo list --search whisper --jq '.results[].full_name'

melange repo view <[account/]name> [--json|--jq|--template]
  Show one repository (name, visibility, type, use case, tags, description,
  timestamps). Exit 1 includes not-found.
  Example: melange repo view zetic/whisper-tiny --jq .is_private

melange repo create <name> [--private] [--model-type general|llm]
    [--use-case vision|nlp|llm|speech|other] [--description S] [--tag T ...]
  Create a repository in your own account (write scope required). Confirmation
  goes to stderr; --json prints the created resource. 409 name conflict and
  403 missing scope surface as exit 1.
  Example: melange repo create whisper-tiny --private --json --jq .full_name

melange repo edit <[account/]name> [--description S] [--visibility public|private]
    [--use-case vision|nlp|llm|speech|other] [--tag T ...] [--json|--jq]
  Patch only the fields passed. --description "" clears it; repeated --tag
  replaces the complete tag set. Visibility changes are owner-only.
  Example: melange repo edit acme/whisper-tiny --tag asr --tag tiny --json

melange repo delete <account/name> [--confirm ACCOUNT/NAME]
  Irreversibly delete a repository. The full name is always required. Agents
  and other non-interactive callers must repeat it exactly with --confirm;
  interactive terminals prompt for the full name.
  Example: melange repo delete acme/obsolete --confirm acme/obsolete

## melange model

Upload models and track conversion. -R ACCOUNT/REPO is REQUIRED on every
model command; there is no default repository.

melange model upload MODEL_FILE -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--input FILE ...]
    [--bucket INDEX:DIMxDIM... ...] [--external-data FILE ...]
    [--input-manifest FILE] [--dry-run] [--wait]
    [--timeout 30m] [--resume ID | --cancel ID [--yes] | --sessions] [--json]
  Resumable upload session: manifest (sizes + CRC32C) -> signed-URL streaming
  -> server-side verification -> conversion. --input order defines input_index.
  Inputs are optional; a model-only manifest is valid.
  --dry-run prints the manifest with no network calls. Ctrl-C (exit 130)
  preserves the session and prints the exact resume command on stderr
  ("Resume with: melange model upload --resume <id> -R <repo>"); resumed
  uploads never re-send acknowledged bytes. Expired-URL reissue intentionally
  mints fresh URLs without Idempotency-Key; create/complete/cancel retain keys.
  Example: melange model upload -R acme/whisper model.onnx --input a.bin --wait
  Bucketed .pt2: repeat --bucket in declaration order. Split --input files into
  one equal-sized group per bucket; order inside each group is input_index.
  Example: melange model upload -R acme/vision model.pt2 \
    --bucket 0:1x3x224x224 --input image224.npy --input mask224.npy \
    --bucket 1:1x3x384x384 --input image384.npy --input mask384.npy --dry-run --json
  With --wait, structured output is
  {"model": <created ModelRef>, "status": <final ModelStatusResponse>}.
  Use --jq .model.key for identity and --jq .status.state for outcome.
  Without --wait, --json remains the raw upload-complete response.
  --input-manifest is a CLI-private local-file JSON document (not the public
  wire manifest). Shape example:
    {"manifest_version":2,"files":[
      {"path":"models/model.onnx","role":"model"},
      {"path":"samples/audio.npy","role":"input","input_index":0}]}
  Each path is resolved relative to the manifest file. filename is optional;
  input_index defaults by input order. Bucketed documents add options.buckets
  ({"index":0,"dims":[1,3,224,224]}) and bucket_index on each input.

Resolve opaque model and target IDs from API results; never invent them:
  model_key=$(melange model list -R acme/whisper --jq '.results[]|select(.is_default)|.key')
  target_id=$(melange model targets "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --jq '.results[0].target_id')

melange model status MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--wait] [--timeout 30m] [--json]
  Conversion status: state (converting/optimizing/ready/failed), stage,
  downloadable, sanitized failure code. Plain read always exits 0; with --wait
  exit 0 = ready, 1 = failed or timeout.
  Example: melange model status "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --jq .state

melange model list -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--limit 1..100] [--paginate|--all] [--json|--jq]
  List a repository's models, newest first. TTY: table (KEY, VERSION, TYPE,
  STATE, DEFAULT, CREATED); non-TTY: TSV; --json: the page envelope.
  Example: melange model list -R acme/whisper --jq '.results[]|select(.is_default)|.key'

melange model view MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--json|--jq|--template]
  Show one model (version, type, state, default, source, terminal/download-ready
  flags, failure code, timestamps). Exit 1 includes not-found.
  Example: melange model view "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --jq .download_ready

melange model targets MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--json|--jq]
  List a model's converted targets. TTY table; non-TTY TSV; --json passthrough.
  Example: melange model targets "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --json

melange model set-default MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--json]
  Pin the repository's default model. Example: melange model set-default "$model_key" -R acme/whisper

melange model import HF_REPO -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--wait] [--timeout 30m] [--json]
  Import an LLM from a public HuggingFace repo (repo must be model type llm) and
  convert it. --wait polls to a terminal state (exit 0 ready, 1 failed/timeout,
  130 interrupted). With --wait, structured output is
  {"model": <raw import response>, "status": <final ModelStatusResponse>}.
  Without --wait, --json remains the raw import response.
  Example: melange model import meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B -R acme/llm --wait --jq .model.key

melange model download MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO --target TARGET_ID --yes [--output PATH|-] [--json]
  BILLABLE, cross-process replay-safe artifact download. The authorization key
  is target-scoped in per-user application state; output corrections keep it, and a process lock
  plus completion/recovery tombstone protects concurrent followers. Transient
  GETs retry, expired URLs refresh with the same key, and 30s without progress
  triggers a retry. --output never overwrites without --force. Known collisions
  validate before charging, but server artifact names arrive after authorization;
  those collisions retain replay state for the instructed --force rerun.
  Agents/non-TTY runs must pass --yes. --output - supports one artifact and
  writes fully staged, verified bytes; it cannot combine with structured output.
  Download --json redacts signed URLs rather than preserving the response bytes.
  Example: melange model download "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --target "$target_id" --output ./models --yes

## melange deploy

Get deterministic, credential-safe SDK deployment code for a converted model.

melange deploy options [--json|--jq|--template]
  List supported languages and inference modes. Languages: android-kotlin,
  android-java, ios-swift, flutter. Modes: auto, speed, accuracy. React Native
  is not supported.

melange deploy guide MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO
    [--language android-kotlin|android-java|ios-swift|flutter]
    [--mode auto|speed|accuracy] [--json|--jq|--template]
  Print ordered Markdown with SDK install and inference snippets. Defaults
  match the dashboard: android-kotlin + auto. The model repository, key,
  version, family, and selected mode are resolved by public-v1. General model
  tensors remain an explicit model-specific TODO. JSON returns the structured
  guide. Output always uses YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY and never interpolates the active
  PAT. MODEL_KEY is a Melange repository model key, never a Hugging Face ID.
  Example: melange deploy guide "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --language ios-swift --mode speed

## melange report

Read a model's benchmark report. -R ACCOUNT/REPO is required.

melange report view MODEL_KEY -R ACCOUNT/REPO [--type general|llm|package]
    [--mode auto|speed|accuracy] [--json|--jq|--template]
  --type selects the report; without it the CLI probes general -> llm -> package
  and shows the first that exists (exit 1 "no report available" when none do; an
  explicit --type surfaces its own 404). TTY: the dashboard-grade table. General
  is one row per device, a column per (ap_type x precision) present, each cell
  the mode pick's latency in ms; the mode columns are re-derived from the raw
  records (speed=lowest latency; accuracy=highest SNR, ties to lower latency;
  auto=fastest run whose SNR exceeds 20 dB, else speed). --mode fills the cells;
  a per-precision summary block follows. LLM: rows=devices, columns=quant_types,
  cells=tps, plus a per-dataset accuracy section. Package: a mode x metric table.
  Non-TTY: one raw record per line (flat measurement fields) — scripts get the
  measurements, not the derived table. --json follows the raw response-byte
  contract described above.
  Example: melange report view "$model_key" -R acme/whisper --json \
    --jq '[.records[]|select(.ap_type=="npu" and .metric=="latency_ms")]|min_by(.value)'

## melange library

Browse the public model library.

melange library list [--task vision|llm|nlp|speech|other ...] [--search S]
    [--provider P] [--limit 1..100] [--paginate|--all] [--json|--jq]
  List library models. --task repeats (a model matching ANY task is included);
  --search is case- and separator-insensitive across name and full_name
  (hyphens, underscores, slashes, and spaces are ignored); --provider is exact.
  TTY: table (MODEL, PROVIDER, TASK, TYPE, CREATED); non-TTY: TSV; --json: the page envelope.
  Example: melange library list --task vision --provider Zetic --jq '.results[].full_name'

melange library view ACCOUNT/NAME [--json|--jq|--template]
  Show one library model with a readme excerpt (first 10 lines on a TTY). TSV
  omits the readme; --json includes the full text.
  Example: melange library view zetic/whisper-tiny --jq .readme

  ACCOUNT/NAME identifies a public repository, not a converted MODEL_KEY. Read
  its existing default model and report directly, without importing/uploading:
    repo=$(melange library list --search QUERY --jq '.results[0].full_name')
    key=$(melange model list -R "$repo" --jq '.results | (map(select(.is_default and .state=="ready")) + map(select(.state=="ready")))[0].key // empty')
    [ -n "$key" ] || { echo "No ready model is available in $repo" >&2; exit 1; }
    melange report view "$key" -R "$repo" --json
    melange deploy guide "$key" -R "$repo" --language android-kotlin --mode auto
  Never import a library model solely to read its public benchmarks.

melange library providers [--json|--jq]
  List providers (companies) with model counts. TTY: table (NAME, MODELS);
  non-TTY: TSV; --json: the envelope.
  Example: melange library providers --jq '.results[]|select(.model_count>=10)|.name'

## melange usage

Current billing-period usage counters and plan quotas.

melange usage [--json|--jq|--template]
  Show active_devices, bandwidth, model_uploads, prompts. TTY: human block;
  non-TTY: TSV key/value. Example: melange usage --jq .prompts

melange usage quotas [--json|--jq|--template]
  Show each counter against its plan limit as "used/limit (pct%)", or "unlimited"
  when the limit is null. TTY: human block; non-TTY: TSV key/value. --json/--jq
  also carry "remaining" per counter — what the server will actually allow now
  (spike headroom included, floored at 0; null = unlimited).
  Example: melange usage quotas --jq .model_uploads.remaining

  Agent disclosure rule: inspect quotas before uploading or claiming benchmark
  coverage is complete. model_uploads.remaining == 0 means do not attempt/retry
  an upload; explain that no upload quota remains on the account's plan, not that
  the CLI is broken. Report records include only caller-visible devices; never
  call them the full benchmark unless completeness is established. Plan identity
  is knowable via `melange plan`; when remaining is 0 and the plan is Free/Lite,
  say the plan is why, otherwise say the monthly quota is exhausted. Check
  `melange plan` rather than inferring the cause from a zero, record counts, or
  HTTP errors.

## melange plan

Effective billing plan for the token's account.

melange plan [--json|--jq|--template]
  Show plan (free|lite|pro|pro_plus|enterprise), is_trial, trial_ends_at. TTY:
  human block; non-TTY: TSV key/value. Reflects what the server enforces: an
  account that bypasses quota limits reports pro_plus with unlimited quotas,
  matching the dashboard. Exit 0 success, 1 API error, 2 usage error, 4 not
  authenticated. Example: melange plan --jq .plan

## melange api

Escape hatch: authenticated request to any /v1 endpoint; raw response body to
stdout (also on non-2xx, with a one-line summary on stderr).

melange api <path> [-X METHOD] [-f key=value] [-F key=value] [-H 'Name: v']
    [--input FILE|-] [-q JQ] [-t TEMPLATE] [-i|--include] [--silent]
  Paths are host-relative and must resolve under /v1 ("/v1/me"; query strings
  allowed); absolute URLs and paths outside /v1 are rejected (exit 2), as are
  ones that leave /v1 only after dot segments or percent-escapes resolve.
  Default method GET; fields or --input switch it to POST. With
  explicit -X GET, fields become query parameters. -f = string field; -F =
  typed (true/false/null/int; @path file contents; @- stdin); key[sub]=v
  nests one level; key[]=v appends arrays. Fields imply a JSON body.
  GET/HEAD and Idempotency-Key requests are retried automatically; pagination
  and polling are the caller's responsibility.
  Example: melange api /v1/me --jq .account.name

## melange version / completion

melange version   Print version ("melange version X (commit date)").
melange completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell   Shell completion scripts.
